script.title: THE SITTER INTERVIEW
script.story_hook: A dad interviews a babysitter before date night.
script.intro_zh: 一位爸爸在約會之夜前面試保母。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a parent interviews a new sitter. Listen for rules, rates, and routines.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一位爸爸面試新保母。留意規則、工資與日常流程的說法。
script.outro: The sitter is in, the kids are ready.
script.outro_zh: 保母到位，孩子也準備好了。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the sitter interview lines.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀面試保母的說法。
script.char_a_description: a man in his late thirties with short sandy hair and wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a forest green flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki shorts and clean sneakers, broad shoulders
script.char_b_description: a petite college girl around twenty with honey-blonde shoulder-length hair and round sunglasses pushed on her head, wearing a cream cable-knit sweater, plaid skirt with black tights, canvas sneakers, bright cheerful face

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, Maya? Come on in. Sorry, tiny chaos.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈmɑjə kʌm ɑn ɪn ˈsɑɹi ˈtaɪni ˈkeɪɑs/
dialogue.zh: 妳好，瑪雅？請進。抱歉，家裡有點小混亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally normal. I've seen worse, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəli ˈnɔɹməl aɪv sɪn wɜɹs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 很平常呀。說實話，我見過更亂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Theo, six, and Mia, three, are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /θioʊ siks ænd ˈmiə θɹi ɑɹ jʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 六歲的西奧和三歲的米雅就交給妳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great ages. What's bedtime look like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈedʒəz wʌts ˈbɛdˌtaɪm lʊk laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這年紀很好帶。睡覺時間怎麼安排？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bath, two books, lights out at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæθ tu bʊks laɪts aʊt æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 洗澡、兩本繪本，八點熄燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, got it. Does Mia fight it?
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɡɑt ɪt dʌz ˈmiə faɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 八點，記下了。米雅會不肯睡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She tries. The sticker chart always works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi traɪz ðə ˈstɪkɚ tʃɑɹt ˈɔlweɪz wɜɹks/
dialogue.zh: 她會抗爭一下。但貼紙獎勵表一定有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stickers beat arguing. Smart system.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪkɚz bit ˈɑɹɡjuɪn smɑɹt ˈsɪstəm/
dialogue.zh: 貼紙比吵架管用。真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, about the rate?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm əˈbaʊt ðə ɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個，呃，關於工資……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said twenty an hour in the text.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ˈtwɛnti æn ˈaʊɚ ɪn ðə tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 訊息裡說好一小時二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Twenty-two after eight, since it's late.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtwɛnti tu ˈæftɚ eɪt sɪns ɪts leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對！八點之後是二十二，因為比較晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds fair. Do I get a break?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz fɛɹ du aɪ ɡɛt ə bɹeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來公道。我有休息時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once they're asleep, grab a snack, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ðeɪɹ əˈslip ɡɹæb ə snæk ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 等他們睡著，妳可以吃點東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, what do I need to know?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɜɹˈfɛkt naʊ wʌt du aɪ nid tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好。有哪些是我必須知道的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two big things. First, the allergy rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɪɡ θɪŋz fɜɹst ði əˈlɜɹdʒi ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 有兩件大事。第一，過敏規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peanuts? I keep my own lunch nut-free.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪˈnʌts aɪ kip maɪ oʊn lʌntʃ nʌt fri/
dialogue.zh: 花生嗎？我自備的午餐都不含花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly—both kids. Theo's is mild, Mia's isn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli boʊθ kɪdz θioʊz ɪz maɪld ˈmiəz ɪzənt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，兩個孩子都是。西奧較輕微，米雅就嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no peanut butter, and no shared knives.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ ˈpinʌt ˈbʌtɚ ænd noʊ ʃɛɹd naɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 那花生醬不碰，刀具也不共用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Jars live on the top shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt dʒɑɹz lɪv ɑn ðə tɑp ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 對。花生醬都放在最上層的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. What's the second big thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd wʌts ðə ˈsɛkənd bɪɡ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。第二件大事是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bathroom routine. Theo asks three times. Always.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæθˈɹum ɹuˈtin θioʊ æsks θɹaɪm ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 上廁所的固定流程。西奧睡前一定問三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times? Like, "do I really have to"?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹaɪm taɪmz laɪk du aɪ ˈɹiəli hæv tə/
dialogue.zh: 三次？是那種「我真的非去不可嗎」？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one. Be patient, it's part of the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn bi ˈpeɪʃənt ɪts pɑɹt əv ðə dil/
dialogue.zh: 就是那種。請有耐心，這是工作的一部份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem at all. My little brothers did that.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm æt ɔl maɪ ˈlɪtəl ˈbrʌðɚz dɪd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題。我家弟弟以前也這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, emergency numbers are on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪˈmɜɹdʒənsi ˈnʌmbɚz ɑɹ ɑn ðə fɹɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，緊急電話都貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw the magnets from the doorway.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ ðə ˈmæɡnɛts fɹʌm ðə ˈdɔɹˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛在門口就看到那些磁鐵便條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, sharp eyes. That's 9-1-1, us, and Grandma.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃɑɹp aɪz ðæts naɪn wʌn wʌn ʌs ænd ˈɡɹæmmɑ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，眼睛真利。上面是911、我們，還有外婆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if I can't reach you at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ kænt ɹitʃ ju æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 如果我完全聯絡不上你們呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then call Uncle Ben. His number's second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kɔl ˈʌŋkəl bɛn hɪz ˈnʌmbɚz ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 那就打給班叔叔，他的號碼排第二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Do they ever skip naps?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt du ðeɪ ˈɛvɚ skɪp næps/
dialogue.zh: 收到。他們會不會不午睡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia skips, then crashes by six-fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə skɪps ðɛn kɹæʃɛz baɪ sɪks ˈfɪftin/
dialogue.zh: 米雅不午睡的話，六點十五就撐不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sugar and no nap is a wild combo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ ænd noʊ næp ɪz ə waɪld ˈkɑmboʊ/
dialogue.zh: 吃糖又不午睡，後果會很瘋狂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've learned that fast. Any questions so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /juv lɜrnd ðæt fæst ˈɛnɪ ˈkwɛstʃənz soʊ fɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 妳學得好快。到目前有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, can they have screen time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kæn ðeɪ hæv skɹim taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 呃，他們可以看螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, shows picked ahead, nothing new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts ʃoz pɪkt əˈhɛd ˈnʌθɪŋ nu/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，節目提前挑好，不看新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. What's off limits completely?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil wʌts ɔf ˈlɪmɪts kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 成交。什麼是完全不能碰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stove, and the locked hall closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊv ænd ðə lɑkt hɔl ˈklɑsət/
dialogue.zh: 爐台，還有上了鎖的走廊儲藏室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A locked closet mystery. Got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɑkt ˈkloʊzət ˈmɪstɚi ɡɑt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鎖起來的神秘櫃子。記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only toys inside. Dinner is pasta at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tɔɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ˈdɪnɚ ɪz ˈpɑstə æt siks/
dialogue.zh: 裡面只有玩具。晚餐六點吃意麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pasta is safe. Where do snacks hide here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑstə ɪz seɪf wɛɹ du snæks haɪd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 意麵很安全。家裡的零食都藏在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Second drawer, crackers only, help yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ sɛkənd dɹɔɹ ˈkɹækɚz ˈonli hɛlp jʊɹsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 哈！第二個抽屜，只有餅乾，妳隨意拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Now references—do you need any?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl naʊ ˈɛfɚənsəz du ju nid ˈɛnɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。推薦人這事——你們需要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, honestly, one would really set my mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑnəstli wʌn wʊd ˈɹɪəli sɛt maɪ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 呃，說實話，有一位推薦人我就安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. The Nguyens, four Fridays straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ðə ˈnjujənz fɔɹ ˈfɹaɪdeɪz stɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然。阮先生一家，連續四個週五都是我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four in a row? They're repeat clients?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ ɪn ə ɹoʊ ðɛɹ ɹiˈpit ˈklaɪənts/
dialogue.zh: 連續四次？他們是固定回來的客戶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They texted me a poem the kids wrote.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ tɛkst mi ə ˈpoʊəm ðə kɪdz ɹot/
dialogue.zh: 他們還傳了一首孩子寫給我的詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now I'm sold. Um, one last thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ naʊ aɪm soʊld ʌm wʌn læst θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我徹底放心了。呃，最後一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好說，是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sweater—can you roll sleeves at bath time?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈswɛtɚ kæn ju ɹoʊl slivz æt bæθ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 關於妳的毛衣——洗澡時能把袖子捲起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, yes, sweater tucked, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jɛs ˈswɛtɚ təkt doʊnt ˈwɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，可以，毛衣塞好好的，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, first-time dad question. I overthink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi fɜɹst taɪm dæd ˈkwɛstʃən aɪ ˈoʊvɚθɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，新手爸爸的傻問題。我就是想太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was a good question, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wʌz ə ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃən ˈtɹulɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，那是個好問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, same schedule next Friday, maybe Saturdays too.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ seɪm ˈskɛdʒʊl nɛkst ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈmeɪbi ˈsætɚˌdeɪz tu/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，下週同一時間，也許週六也想請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can do Fridays and one Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn du ˈfɹaɪdeɪz ænd wʌn ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 每週五我都可以，再加一週六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. I'll text the hours and the address.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn aɪl tɛkst ði ˈaʊɚz ænd ði əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。我會把時段和地址再傳給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's already in my notes, color-coded.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn maɪ noʊts ˈkʌlɚ ˈkoʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我早就寫進筆記，還用顏色做了記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Theo, hand Maya your bag. Be polite!
dialogue.phonetic: /θioʊ hænd ˈmɑjə jʊɹ bæɡ bi pəˈlaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 西奧，把背包交給瑪雅。要有禮貌！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, he handed me the cat plush too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hi ˈhændɪd mi ðə kæt plʊʃ tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈，他連貓咪玩偶也一起塞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's his lucky cat. He's serious, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts hɪz ˈlʌki kæt hiz ˈsɪɹiəs ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 那是他的幸運貓。我是認真的，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got the cat. Have a great date night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ðə kæt hæv ə ɡɹeɪt deɪt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 貓咪玩偶收到。祝你們約會之夜開心。

script.youtube_description:
約會之夜前兩小時，保母上門，該問的話一句都不能漏。這一集用60句自然英文，完整呈現一場保母面試：睡覺流程、花生過敏的鐵律、時薪與晚班加價、緊急聯絡人、推薦人，還有新手爸爸不好意思開口的毛衣問題。

你會聽到：
- 睡前流程：「Bath, two books, lights out at eight.」
- 過敏確認：「So no peanut butter, and no shared knives.」
- 工資談法：「Twenty-two after eight, since it's late.」
- 緊急聯絡：「Then call Uncle Ben. His number's second.」

這些說法在美洲家庭天天在用，聽熟就能自己面試保母。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽完整段對話，再一句一句模仿，讓句子變成口語直覺。

祝你把鑰匙交出去時，安心踏實。

script.youtube_description_en:
Date night is in two hours and the sitter is at the door: what must a parent ask before handing over the keys? In 60 short A2 lines you hear a full babysitter interview: the bedtime routine, a serious peanut allergy rule, pay per hour plus the late rate, emergency contacts, references, and even a shy question about sweater sleeves.

You'll hear real American phrasing like "Bath, two books, lights out at eight" and "Then call Uncle Ben". The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice, so every phrase sticks without memorizing.

Made for A2 learners and parents planning their first sitter interview.

script.youtube_description_ref:

今晚要出門約會，保母第一次上門，哪些話非問不可？

這一集帶大家走進客廳的一場保母面試：從八點熄燈的睡覺流程、花生過敏的鐵律，到緊急電話、推薦人，還有新手爸爸鼓起勇氣問出的毛衣問題。

你會聽到：
🛏 睡前流程：「Bath, two books, lights out at eight.」

💵 工資確認：「Twenty-two after eight, since it's late.」
📞 緊急聯絡：「Then call Uncle Ben. His number's second.」

這一集也示範怎麼談休息時間、螢幕時間，以及裝著自由餅乾的那個抽屜。

script.thumbnail_action: handing a stuffed cat to the sitter
